goal: Wire close-time ledger emission into scripts/cmux/dispatch.mjs's closeCmd: an idempotent ensureAgentSession fallback for a dispatch that was never awaited (or whose transcript appeared only at the end), the return envelope, agent_end carrying the record's terminal outcome, endAgentSession with all ten required numeric fields from the reducer (explicit null where unknown), N back-filled tool_call rows with historical timestamps drawn from one seq reservation, and the reconcile boundary evidence as its own decision row. Same file and function area as be-41-04, so it is serialized directly after it. A throwing or degraded ledger must change no close outcome, no exit code, and no JSON key.
constraints: ADR-026 clause 1 / issue #41's core constraint: NO behaviour change. closeCmd's returned {code, json} must stay byte-identical (dispatch.mjs:2334-2342), including the exit-code rule code = (outcome === 'ok' && !uncorroborated) ? 0 : 1, and its cmux invocation count must not change.

ONE LOCK ACQUISITION FOR THE WHOLE BACK-FILL (ADR-027): reserve the full seq range for N tool_call rows plus the envelope/agent_end/decision rows in a SINGLE emitter.reserveSeq call, then emit outside the lock. N reservations for N rows is the anti-pattern this contract exists to prevent.

IDEMPOTENCE MUST BE PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED: agent_sessions has UNIQUE(adw_id, claude_session_id) and every insert is INSERT OR IGNORE, so a duplicate startAgentSession is SILENTLY swallowed. Gate the fallback on the sidecar's session_started flag and assert no second row is created — an assertion that only checks 'a row exists' would pass on the bug.

AMENDED POST-be-41-04 (orchestrator note, added after be-41-04's QA panel): be-41-04 added a 5th field to the per-dispatch sidecar entry beyond the 4 this spec's interface_contract documents — `dispatches[<dispatch_id>].ended: bool`, defaulting false, read by teardownCmd's reconciliation loop as `session_started && !ended` to decide whether a session is still open. closeCmd MUST set `ended: true` on this same entry (via updateSidecar, same pattern be-41-04 uses) whenever it successfully emits endAgentSession for that dispatch — in BOTH the fallback-session and already-awaited-session paths. Failure to do this means teardown will see the entry as still open, emit a SECOND endAgentSession for the same claude_session_id, and — because endAgentSession is an unconditional UPDATE of all ten fields, not a merge — the never-sighted-transcript branch (all ten fields explicit null) will overwrite the real token figures closeCmd already recorded. A test must assert that after closeCmd runs, a subsequent teardownCmd does NOT re-emit endAgentSession for that dispatch (assert the sqlite row's token fields are unchanged by teardown, not just that teardown ran without error).

PAYLOAD DISCIPLINE: never pass a key PAYLOAD_KEYS (ledger.mjs:89-101) drops. agent_end is exactly {role, outcome, dispatch_id}; tool_call is exactly {tool, ok}; decision is exactly {decided, why, alternatives}. In particular escalate_to is NOT passed.

NO WORKER-AUTHORED PROSE in any row (conventions.md 2026-08-08). The decision row's fields are dispatcher-authored, closed-vocabulary values plus counts — never a return body, a reviewer's prose, a reason string, or a transcript excerpt. If the reconcile evidence you want to mirror is free text, mirror a count and a closed enum instead.
C4 — three unrelated 'warnings' shapes, three mappings, never one generic mirror (see interface_contract).
Explicit null, never omission: endAgentSession requires all ten fields and requireFields rejects only undefined (ledger.mjs:645-655, :993-998). context_window is always null (U-4).
Every emission passes an explicit seq (ADR-027) — never let ledger.mjs's nextSeq allocate.

tool_call rows carry HISTORICAL started_at/ended_at from the reducer. recordEvent defaults BOTH to now() for type 'tool_call' when they are absent (ledger.mjs:809-810), so an omitted timestamp silently fabricates a wrong time.
conventions.md 2026-08-01: no typecheck/lint tooling exists — validation is the filtered test run only.
acceptance_criteria: ensureAgentSession FALLBACK IS IDEMPOTENT: a dispatch whose await already started its agent session gets NO second agent_sessions row on close (assert the row COUNT is 1 and that started_at/transcript_path are unchanged — not merely that a row exists, since INSERT OR IGNORE would hide the bug); a dispatch that was never awaited gets exactly one row on close, with the resolved transcript_path when the transcript is now sightable and explicit null when it is not.

ENVELOPE MIRRORED: recordEnvelope receives all eleven required fields (ledger.mjs:824) including valid, and violation_names (when present) are built as `${path}:${keyword}` — NEVER a validator message, because scripts/cmux/contract.mjs interpolates the offending value into every message (the diagnostic field IS the leak channel; conventions.md 2026-08-08 mirror entry).

agent_end CARRIES THE RECORD'S TERMINAL OUTCOME: payload is exactly {role, outcome, dispatch_id} where outcome is the value closeCmd itself resolved (record.outcome on the already-terminal branch, mapOutcome(classification, fsState) with the postcondition override applied otherwise — dispatch.mjs:2206-2234), never a re-derivation.

endAgentSession LANDS ALL TEN FIELDS from be-41-02's reducer, with every unknown as explicit null; a test drives both the transcript-present case (real figures, deduped) and the never-sighted case (all ten null) and asserts the mirror row.

TOOL_CALL BACK-FILL WITH HISTORICAL TIMESTAMPS: N tool tuples produce N tool_call rows whose started_at/ended_at come from the transcript, NOT from now() (assert the stored timestamps differ from the test clock's now); the whole batch consumes exactly ONE seq reservation (assert the sidecar's reserved_through advanced once) and every row survives (assert the row count, not just the first row).

RECONCILE EVIDENCE AS A decision ROW: payload is exactly {decided, why, alternatives} drawn from dispatcher-authored closed vocabulary plus counts; a test asserts that a hostile reconcile warning string (ANSI escapes, an embedded newline, 5000 chars) reaches NO ledger row, NO stderr line and NO file under stateDir.

JSON SURFACE FROZEN: test/cmux-dispatch.test.mjs asserts closeCmd's {code, json} with assert.deepEqual against a frozen expected object across at least the ok, refused, refused_postcondition and already-terminal branches — plus the terminal_outcome_uncorroborated case, where code stays 1.

NEVER LOAD-BEARING — MUTATION TEST (not inspection): with the emitter forced into total failure (a handle whose every writer throws, and separately a below-floor degraded handle), closeCmd returns a deepEqual-identical {code, json}, terminates the record identically on disk, unlinks the nonce identically, and makes the same number of cmux invocations (assert against the fake-cmux log). Verify the test is non-vacuous by temporarily moving one emission outside the facade and confirming it fails.

EVERY PRE-EXISTING CLOSE TEST PASSES UNCHANGED, none modified to accommodate emission and none skipped. A pre-existing assertion that becomes unsatisfiable means the design was violated — return `insufficient` instead of editing it.

ADVERSARIAL PANEL REQUIRED: scripts/cmux/*.mjs is deep-review class and dispatch.mjs is the dispatcher runtime (config.md:46), so this slice takes the 3-reviewer adversarial panel (behaviour-invariance lens, worker-influenced-bytes/evidence-integrity lens, contract-coherence lens) plus a dev-team:test-engineer mutation pass — test-engineer owns mutations beyond those named here (idempotence guard removed, historical timestamps dropped, seq reservation split per row, violation_names switched to message).
The filtered test run in validation_commands passes with no test deleted or skipped.

interface_contract:
CONSUMED HERE (produced by be-41-01 and be-41-02) — referenced, never redefined.

=== RUN SIDECAR — <stateDir>/ledger/run.json (be-41-01) ===
{ adw_id, repo_slug, task_slug, db_path, jsonl_path, created_at, phase: {name, seq, phase_id, started_at}, seq: { event: {next, reserved_through}, phase: {next, reserved_through} }, gate_attempts: {"<gate_name>": n}, heartbeats: {"<claude_session_id>": iso}, billed: {input, output, cache_write, cache_read}, stats: {emitted, dropped, lock_giveups, resolution_ambiguous, resolution_missing, payload_keys_dropped}, dispatches: {"<dispatch_id>": {claude_session_id, transcript_path|null, session_started: bool, sighted_at|null}} }
The dispatches map's session_started flag is what makes this slice's ensureAgentSession fallback idempotent; the billed map is the accumulator teardown drains.

=== EMITTER FACADE (scripts/factory/emit.mjs, be-41-01) ===
openRun({stateDir, repoSlug, taskSlug, dbPath?, nodeVersion?, now?, stderr?}) -> emitter · sidecar() · reserveSeq(kind, n) -> number[] · updateSidecar(patchFn) -> boolean · emit(fn) -> boolean · stats() · dispose(). EVERY method is never-throwing; every emission passes an explicit seq; a lock give-up drops the emission, counts it and returns a falsy value — it NEVER blocks or throws.

=== C2 — AgentUsage (be-41-02) ===
readUsage({transcriptPath}) -> the ten fields endAgentSession requires, computed AFTER dedupe by message.id (last occurrence in file order wins): billed_input_tokens = SUM(input_tokens); billed_output_tokens = SUM(output_tokens); billed_cache_write_tokens = SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens); billed_cache_read_tokens = SUM(cache_read_input_tokens); raw_read_tokens = SUM(input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens) with cache_read_input_tokens EXCLUDED; raw_written_tokens = SUM(output_tokens); context_tokens = the last surviving message's (input + cache_read + cache_creation); context_window = null (U-4). PINNED ASSUMPTION: a worker session never spawns subagents, so no <session-id>/subagents/*.jsonl walk is required — DISALLOWED_TOOLS (scripts/cmux/contract.mjs:12, frozen) excludes Task/Agent/mcp__* and is always applied (scripts/cmux/record.mjs:572, :651). RE-ENTRY CONDITION: if any role ever gains Task, these numbers silently under-count.

=== ToolCallTuple (be-41-02) ===
readToolCalls({transcriptPath}) -> [{tool, ok, started_at, ended_at}]. `tool` is a member of a closed, shape-guarded set (unrecognized -> the literal 'other'); `ok` is false for both a failed and a denied call (U-3); started_at/ended_at are the transcript's own historical ISO timestamps, which is what keeps recordEvent from defaulting both to now() (scripts/factory/ledger.mjs:809-810). Keys map onto PAYLOAD_KEYS.tool_call = ['tool','ok'].

=== C4 — no shared `warnings` reader ===
Three unrelated shapes carry the word 'warning' here: ladder.reconcile().warnings is string[]; scripts/chain/gates.mjs's buildReport has NO warnings key at all (:502-508 — its only warnings-adjacent code folds lintResult.warnings into a COUNT inside a note string, :421-428); and the {check, detail, severity} object shape lives in dispatch.mjs:1392-1393 (spec-lint warnings). #41 mirrors each through its OWN mapping function; NEVER one generic warnings mirror.
